title: Alma Mahler's birth chart
metaDescription: Alma Mahler's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 7.6° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The chart's headline is an opposition: the Sun and Jupiter within 0.1°, identity wired to expansion. Across the wheel, each body sees the other in full. The old reading is not conflict so much as permanent mutual visibility.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 7.6° Virgo: the first decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Mercury. A earth sign, read here in its first face.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Mercury holds 25.6° Leo, Venus holds 8.4° Libra, Mars holds 20.5° Taurus — in the old shorthand, a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste led by wit and proportion; drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Jupiter hold the closest angle here — an opposition, 0.1° wide. Across the wheel, each body sees the other in full. The old reading is not conflict so much as permanent mutual visibility. Behind it, Mercury square Pluto at 1.8°, and the Sun conjunction Uranus at 2.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, four sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Libra at 8.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Taurus at 20.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Pisces at 7.8° is in domicile; Saturn in Aries at 14.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 earth, 2 fire, 1 air, 1 water; by modality, 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 2 cardinal. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aquarius into Pisces during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.9° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
